<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI shifts to calibrated tightening:</strong> The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, with analysts projecting further hikes to reach a terminal rate of 6.0% to combat inflation and support the rupee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOaHBfZmwzZ055OFBsUE9MSXRWUUhHalh4bHlrUnpDZmhSZ2w1dEU0bG8xQkFwWTd1SFgxQ2ppbHRGQzBOQ1BHdWFLcU9qRkVQenJLSnZfVUNpWVhFYWVzWmRRNnBYRWtqVGUwYkJRaEhWaG1TRFN1a1ZBRU9iTXBFcVN1NkE5NVFfUlZuTXNoNVJnNWJYU2gzTFhhclBBZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPTllLMmNLTFlvSlA4THZQUkZpM2Vxc2hER2pzOFVEY3RnSjVmTFRhaW10V0xzLWJ4dm9wenF3QzY4cXEyTlJPSjBzbVZpN0MzN1hmaHZadzVKOVFMRmdpaTRDRldFYVliU25OSjF4U1l2bk12c3FPTUFXQnRGcXBfNlM2Y2pjTHZGSzBzb2FRVDNvWTRtZmRJaUNB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market volatility and FII outflows:</strong> Indian indices have hit multi-month lows, pressured by a massive $40 billion exit by FIIs over the past two years, despite occasional rebounds in sectors like IT.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency intervention:</strong> The RBI has moved to support the rupee, which has faced significant depreciation pressure, by cracking down on forex derivatives and facing calls to prioritize currency stability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>
